items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I finally got a chance to meet Donald Lambert once.

ctx.x: Lambert, who was supposed to be the king of the stride piano. And Art said that the guy really could play. He said it took him almost all night to convince this guy though, he said, and finally just after they had almost finished then he laid "Tiger Rag" on him, and that crushed him. So I got a -- and that just killed Fats. Fats sat there and he just laughed and he just enjoyed the whole thing.

I finally got a chance to meet Donald Lambert once. They did one of these jazz festivals or something, at WNEW. They used to have them yearly in New York, and Donald Lambert was there and I met him, and he could play. Stride piano. But Art was the master.
Art kind of liked to I'd like to kind of wait until everybody was through and then cut everybody down. I've heard stories about that.
